title: Dispatch validated Python proposals through the canonical Swift Skill boundary
goal: Provide a Swift entry point that consumes a versioned Python plan envelope and routes only supported create-file proposals through the existing Agent scope, Settings policy, workspace controls, Skill/Module execution, and read-back verification.
context: PYAGENT-001 provides deterministic Python planning and PYAGENT-002 validates the schema-v1 envelope in Swift. This task connects validated proposal data to the existing execution boundary without embedding or invoking a Python interpreter; a future host integration can supply the JSON bytes.
forbidden_changes: Do not invoke Python, shell, network, or direct filesystem APIs from the dispatch entry point.
Do not call ModuleRuntime or workspace tools directly from the Python proposal boundary.
Do not let a Python proposal authorize capabilities, bypass Agent scope, Settings policy, approval, workspace checks, or read-back verification.
Do not wire an unavailable Python interpreter into the app or claim the Python runtime is running on iOS.
Do not modify App/ or PersonalAgent.xcodeproj.
acceptance_criteria: A valid schema-v1 workspace.create-file proposal is transformed into the canonical supported Chat command and executed only through runChatSkillIfMatched.
The returned result is reported verified only when the canonical Skill result identifies workspace.create-file and verified=true.
Clarification, conversational, and unsupported plans do not invoke Skill execution.
Workspace-disabled configuration fails closed without creating a file.
Malformed and path-traversal proposals are rejected before execution.
Regression tests cover exact content/read-back, disabled workspace, non-actionable plans, and invalid proposals.
Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
verification: Confirm Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
recovery: If any proposal fails validation or the canonical runtime declines it, preserve the failure outcome and keep the workspace unchanged. Do not add a direct executor fallback.
